title: DomainConfig
description:
The complete `domain.config.json` tree, after normalization.

Every block is also overridable per service through
`services.metadata.<block>`, see `rules.effective_service_config`. The
service row wins over these globals.

Capabilities.description:
The on/off spine. A false capability means the UI hides the surface AND
the backend refuses the write, not one without the other.
Capabilities.title: Capabilities

perDayMinorUnits.description: Declared but NOT enforced: it needs the customer's other bookings that day, which is a query, not arithmetic.

landingSubtitle.default: Pick a resource, find an open slot, book it.

quoteRequested.default: Your quote request has been sent.

depositDue.default: A deposit is due to confirm this booking.

prerequisiteBlocked.default: Some details are needed before this can be confirmed.

LegacyRules.description:
DEPRECATED. `timing` owns these five keys; `normalize()` mirrors them back
here so a v1 reader and a v1 config file both keep working.
LegacyRules.title: LegacyRules

LegacySearch.description: DEPRECATED. `discovery` owns this; `normalize()` keeps the two in sync.
LegacySearch.title: LegacySearch

timezone.description: The business's own IANA timezone. Absent in v1, which is why an anonymous visitor always saw availability grouped in UTC.

type.description: 'string' is accepted as an alias for 'text', it shipped in domain.config.medical.example.json and matched nothing in the v1 validator.

MetaFields.description:
Custom fields per entity. Adding one needs no migration, the values land
in that table's `metadata` jsonb column.
MetaFields.title: MetaFields

max.description: null means the resource's own capacity is the ceiling.

composition.description: Age bands and similar, each with its own priceFactor.

noShowFee.description: NOT YET ENFORCED, needs the payments layer (no payments table exists).

adapter.description: No PSP exists in this repo. 'manual' = the owner marks a booking paid.

chargePerPerson.description: True reproduces the v1 formula (price x slots x party). False where the party shares one unit, a tennis court costs the same for 2 or 4.

providerCode.description: Required when mode is 'single', how the app resolves its one business.

selfOnboarding.description: Defaults to (mode == 'multi') at load: a marketplace onboards businesses, a single-business site does not.

Terms.description:
Every noun the UI renders. All 17 keys are required to be non-empty
strings, the frontend's `<Term>` has nothing to fall back to.
Terms.title: Terms

approvalWindowHours.description: NOT YET ENFORCED, auto-expiring a stale request needs a scheduled job.
